provider: actual selected provider; this profile is none
searches: Object keyed by exact input.queries labels in declaration order. Each value is every actually returned original public memory_search.details field, retaining complete results, warning, error, unavailable, action, debug and any extra fields; no synthesis/omission.
dispatches: Object keyed by the same query labels; each value has exactly managerSearches and bootstrapAttempts. Native managerSearches counts original exact-owner search method entries within this actual public tool call. Native bootstrapAttempts counts original exact-owner syncAdmitted entries whose actual args.reason is search-bootstrap. SDK managerSearches counts original exact-owner search entries in this actual public tool call. SDK bootstrapAttempts counts actual Managed search repair request journals reason=search-bootstrap within this call, cross-checked against original reindex entries. Counts are not expected literals and are derived from real events, never tool result shape.
sources: Object with initial and afterClose arrays. Each array is sorted actual union of declared and discovered workspace source paths. Each file has exact path,kind=file,text,hex,sha256,size,mtimeMs. Missing sources have path,kind=missing. Real independent source bytes/stat carriers remain raw.
publicCarriers: Retain complete actual original tool envelopes and serialized text before any private codec; assert parsing original text equals original details independently. Raw envelope APIs are not claimed identical.
rawOnly: All other original engine-specific read-generation leases, physical SQL tables, owner/acquisition/status/lifecycle records, real errors, worker requests/replies and internal counters remain complete custody. No internal worker/task count equality, binary SQL identity, source-to-release reproduction or whole-boundary acceptance is claimed.
normalization: None. Preserve every common result field and numeric value exactly.
failureRetention: Original first actual execution is retained even if it fails or differs. A transport failure or missing capture is not a match; no automatic host retries. An actual tool returning an unavailable envelope is a real result, not a fabricated fallback.
completion: After second public call returns, original owner.close joins only already-admitted operations, then capture physical SQL and source state. No intervening query, manual sync, reopen, adapter completion wait or timer drain. Record real close errors, closeAll and final owner state.
oldHostedInvestigation: Paused at user request; no artifact access.
